summary: Every Hugging Face free user receives $0.10 in monthly credits for Inference Providers, subject to change. Credits apply when requests are routed through Hugging Face.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a Hugging Face account and create an access token.
Route requests through Hugging Face Inference Providers so the monthly credits apply.
Use the included credits before enabling additional pay-as-you-go usage.

social_proof.title: Pricing and Billing | Hugging Face Inference Providers
social_proof.text: Free Users receive $0.10 in monthly credits that can be spent on Inference Providers.
